job_details.job_description:
Coditas is an AI-first digital transformation company that blends cutting-edge technology with human-centered design thinking to build products that matter. We are strategic technology partners to globally recognized brands like JPMC, Konica Minolta, Sun Pharma, BCG, KPMG, and more, solving complex, real-world problems, from crafting AI-powered platforms to reimagining how software is built.
But what truly sets us apart is how we work. At Coditas, you're given ownership, not overhead. You're trusted to think boldly, collaborate deeply, and build with purpose. Our Great Place to Work™-certified culture is built around autonomy, craft, and curiosity because we believe the best people don't just want a job, but room to grow and the right problems to solve.
We are seeking aspiring engineers with a passion for clean coding and looking to kickstart their careers in software development. At Coditas, you will get the opportunity to hone your technical and soft skills by working on cutting-edge tech stacks under the guidance of some of the most experienced professionals in the industry.
*   **Stipend:** INR 11,000 per month
*   **Duration:** January 2026 to July 2026 (6 months)
*   **Work location:** Pune, Maharashtra
*   **Internship type:** Work from office
*   **Service Agreement:** This internship program is designed to provide an invaluable experience for professional growth and development. While full-time placement is not guaranteed, Coditas may offer outstanding performers a full-time position with a package of INR 4.5 LPA. This offer is subject to management's decision and the candidate's performance during the internship, with a 12-month service agreement. Forfeiting the same will involve penalty charges on a pro-rata basis.
responsibilities: Participate in a structured training program focused on technical tracks
Participate in workshops, seminars, and interactive sessions designed to enhance technical skills and creative thinking
Write, test, and maintain code that adheres to high-quality standards and follows best practices for scalability, performance, and maintainability.
You will be required to report to our Pune Office for this internship program, 5 days a week.
requirements: A pursuing degree in either BE/BTech-Computer Science, AI/ML/DS/IT, BSc CS, BCA/MCA/M-Tech/BBA CA, or MSc CS with a 65% aggregate and no standing arrears.
Scored 60% or above in 10th and 12th standards
Strong verbal and written communication skills so that you can collaborate well with your team and clients
Problem-solving ability since the job calls for tackling real-world digital problems
A strong work ethic with an eagerness to learn and become a rockstar coder
Basic knowledge of coding, as you're going to be a professional software engineer.
